rule:any-damage-to-creature-triggers-sel.definition: Whenever this creature deals damage of any kind -- combat or noncombat -- to a creature, it grows itself by adding a +1/+1 counter to itself.
rule:any-damage-to-creature-triggers-sel.note: split from rule:combat-damage-to-player-triggers-self-plus1-counter: these members deal damage to a CREATURE, not a player, and make no combat restriction.

moves.why: Spiritmonger and Strax both read 'deals damage to a creature' -- wrong object AND no combat restriction

definition_edits.rule:combat-damage-to-player-triggers-se: Whenever this creature deals COMBAT damage to a PLAYER, it grows itself by adding a +1/+1 counter to itself. Both restrictions are load-bearing: damage to a creature, or damage of any kind, belongs on the any-damage-to-creature- family.
